'''Tebien Ros''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a shop on the [[Promenade]], where he built and sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry.

==Behind the scenes==
Tebien Ros was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears on Nar Shaddaa as an Armstech crew skill trainer.
